scientific_role: candidate-universe reachability diagnosis after the opened CIR08 LOCAL smoke; not confirmation and not selector nomination
opened_outcome_warning: CIR08 2021-2025 public outcomes were already opened in the preceding portable coastal smoke. This diagnostic can diagnose frame structure only and cannot validate or nominate a method.

broad_candidate_frame.rationale: coarse matched broad-frame reachability diagnosis; every lane in this diagnostic uses the same 250-m candidate grid

worldcover_component_map.land_definition: valid WorldCover class other than permanent water class 80
worldcover_component_map.component_rule: 8-neighbour connected components on native 10-m WorldCover land pixels

frozen_lanes.DETACHED_SAME_COMPONENT: >5 km from every historical population but in a WorldCover land component represented by historical populations
frozen_lanes.DETACHED_OTHER_COMPONENT: >5 km from every historical population and in a WorldCover land component not represented by historical populations
frozen_lanes.ANCHORED_COMPONENT_FULL: all candidate cells outside the 0.5-km exclusion in any WorldCover land component represented by historical populations
frozen_lanes.OTHER_COMPONENTS_FULL: all candidate cells outside the 0.5-km exclusion in WorldCover land components not represented by historical populations
frozen_lanes.BROAD_LAND_UNION: all WorldCover land candidate cells in the declared outer frame outside the 0.5-km exclusion

outcome.novel_population_rule: deterministic complete-link 0.5 km; recent cluster is novel when >0.5 km from every strict historical population
outcome.report: candidate count, recovered novel population count, recall, median nearest candidate distance and maximum nearest candidate distance for every frozen lane/radius

decision_rule: diagnostic only; do not promote a lane, tune a distance, impose a component-size threshold, or fit a selector on this opened unit
forbidden: do not change the 5-km LOCAL sensitivity boundary after component scoring
do not remove small WorldCover components after seeing outcomes
do not replace WorldCover components with a favorable segmentation after outcomes
do not fit structural or distance weights in this reachability diagnostic
do not call the result confirmation
do not modify the validated Japanese 2.5% / 10-km product
